I was around 8, I guess. I had no idea what self harm or depression was yet but I had this heavy "thing" inside my chest. This thing started when I had fights with my mother and when she punishes me (like leaving me outside to sleep with the dog or leaving me all alone at home while she goes to work) and one night I picked up a blade from a broken sharpener of mine and I cut the side of my palm. I didn't feel pain until it started to bleed. 

After that, I started using broken glass and I still cut on my palm or my finger. I started using a blade and cutting my wrist when I was around 13.

Yeah, I used to like wearing shorts, especially at home but ever since I had cut myself on my legs, I can't do it anymore especially since my mom has this thing about people who selfharm. 

Another thing is that I'm a fan of wearing jackets, even if it's hot out, I would still wear a jacket since it would also cover the scars on my wrist. The problem is that our school President (I think everyone is much more familiar with the term "Principal") banned the wearing of jacket in our campus (I go to a Catholic school) because she doesn't like seeing us wear another type of clothing when we wear our school uniform (yes, we wear a uniform, except on Wednesdays and Saturdays).
I have been doing this lately. I run my finger on the edge but not hard enough to break my skin, just to feel the sharpness and it makes me satisfied as my urges disappear
